title: Metrics onramp sidecar for inference telemetry (OTel -> Prometheus + KPI enrichment)
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a lightweight 'onramp' sidecar that sits alongside inference serving processes to transform high-cardinality per-request OTel metrics into Prometheus-friendly KPI envelopes while preserving causal links to tracing. Goals: reduce cardinality explosion from per-request labels, attach KV-cache hit/miss and batch-size attributes to key KPIs, emit exemplars that reference traces, and allow tenant-aware sampling policies. The sidecar will act as a translation/aggregation layer (OTLP gRPC input -> batched Prom remote_write or Prom scrape endpoint) and provide a policy layer for deterministic exemplar selection and label canonicalization.
acceptance_criteria: Sidecar accepts OTLP metrics/span exports from local process and exposes a stable Prometheus scrape endpoint
Implements label canonicalization rules to collapse non-essential per-request labels (max cardinality per label configurable)
Emits per-model KPIs: p50/p90/p99 token latency, tokens-per-request distribution, KV cache hit-rate as a percentile and rate, and per-route token-cost counter
Deterministic exemplar generation: exemplars include trace_id/span_id linking to traces stored in our trace backend
Tenant-aware sampling: sampling policy can be configured per-tenant and respects 'priority sampling' flags from request headers
End-to-end tests and a demo dashboard showing before/after reduction in time series count for a synthetic workload
